en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s book lovers are packing the city’s book fair, an annual event run by a government-established statutory body.



People attend the Hong Kong Book Fair in Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, on July 17, 2026. The locations where booths of independent booksellers once stood have been turned into reading areas this year. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
